name: Voice Band
description: Sing a melody and see its notes, play with ten voice effects, and layer a four-track looper band.

about.concept: Pitch and structure made visible. Singing a melody shows its notes on screen, so the child connects what she hears and does with how music is written; the looper shows how layers combine into a piece.
about.progression: Seeing a single sung note leads to melodies, then voice effects that change timbre, then a four-track looper where parts are recorded, timed and layered.
